sources.name: West Africa Dams and Reservoirs Dataset
sources.producer: Kouassi et al. (2026), bonndata University of Bonn
sources.note: Regional dataset counts, not Nigerian catchment totals. No facility points have been ingested, matched or field validated. Country-wise records and site precision require source-file review.

sources.subject: mineral_resources
sources.name: National Mineral Occurrence Database
sources.note: NGSA describes a Microsoft Access database with occurrence locations, commodity, reserve and grade fields; individual records not acquired. Database description is not proof of a particular reserve.

sources.subject: mineral_resources
sources.name: Nigerian Mineral Resources Decision Support System
sources.note: Read-only official decision-support portal; no permission to copy individual geoscience records is asserted.

sources.subject: mineral_resources
sources.name: Nigeria Mineral Resources Database (independent 2026 compilation)
sources.producer: whoisOlaxtra (2026), based on NGSA Mineral Resources Map (2023)
sources.note: 974 occurrence records reported by compiler; compiled from map interpretation, not a primary NGSA structured database, measured mineral reserves or independently verified site positions. Check original NGSA map rights separately.
